'''Ragith III''' was a minor [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], that had been settled by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] for several generations by the time of the [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|Dissolution of the Imperial Senate]]. The [[Ragithian Human]] inhabitants were descendant from colonists genetically bred and selected to adapt to the high [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] of the planet. [[Rodo]] the bouncer came from Ragith III.
